fields.title: Vulnerabilities are found, prioritised and closed to a timeframe

sections.Purpose: We look for weaknesses in our systems rather than waiting to be told about them. We rank what we find by the risk it actually presents. We then close findings inside a set timeframe, or record who is accepting the risk of leaving them open.
sections.Scope:
The full stack of systems we build or operate: application code, dependencies, container images, infrastructure and configuration. It covers findings from our own testing and from external reports.

_Boundary: this policy owns finding a vulnerability, prioritising it and closing it, wherever it lives. Whether a component is one we should have taken on at all (its source, its provenance, its licence) is [pol-TRUS]'s._
sections.Exceptions: A finding may be accepted, rather than fixed, where it is not exploitable in our context or where the fix carries greater risk than the finding. That acceptance is recorded under [pol-DEVI] with a named risk owner and a review date.
